claim.claim-text: 2. The display substrate (100) according to claim 1, wherein

the at least one bonding region insulation layer comprises: a bonding region second gate insulation layer (1243, 2243), and a bonding region interlayer insulation layer (1244, 2244) located on a side of the bonding region second gate insulation layer (1243, 2243) away from the base substrate (1000, 2000); and the at least one bonding region insulation layer comprises a contact pad via hole (1216, 2216, 1219, 2219), and the one of the plurality of data leads (1220, 2220) is connected to the first contact pad metal layer (1215, 2215) through the contact pad via hole (1216, 2216, 1219, 2219).

3. The display substrate (100) according to claim 1 or claim 2, wherein a portion of the edges of the plurality of contact pads (1210, 2210) is sandwiched between the first insulation layer (1230, 2230) and the at least one bonding region insulation layer.

4. The display substrate (100) according to any one of claims 1-3, further comprising: a bonding region first gate insulation layer (1242, 2242), located in the bonding region (1200, 2200), and on a side of the plurality of data leads (1220, 2220) and the at least one bonding region insulation layer close to the base substrate (1000, 2000).

5. The display substrate (100) according to claim 4, wherein the at least one bonding region insulation layer comprises: a first portion located between the first contact pad metal layer (1215, 2215) of one of the plurality of contact pads (1210, 2210) and the one of the plurality of data leads (1220, 2220), a second portion located between the one of the plurality of contact pads (1210, 2210) and the bonding region first gate insulation layer (1242, 2242), and a third portion located between the first insulation layer (1230, 2230) and the bonding region first gate insulation layer (1242, 2242), and the first portion, the second portion and the third portion of the at least one bonding region insulation layer are connected to each other.

6. The display substrate (100) according to any one of claims 1-5, further comprising: a bonding region third insulation layer (2260), located in the bonding region (2200), and provided on a side of the first insulation layer (2230) and the plurality of contact pads (2210) away from the base substrate (2000), and the bonding region third insulation layer (2260) comprises third contact pad via holes (2218) to expose surfaces of the plurality of the contact pads (2210).

7. The display substrate (100) according to claim 6, wherein the bonding region third insulation layer (2260) covers the first insulation layer (2230) and further covers and directly contacts a portion of the plurality of contact pads (2210).

8. The display substrate (100) according to claim 6 or claim 7, further comprising: a second transfer electrode pattern (2270), located in the bonding region (2200) and on a side of the bonding region third insulation layer (2260) away from the base substrate (2000), wherein the second transfer electrode pattern (2270) is electrically connected with the plurality of contact pads (1210, 2210) through the third contact pad via holes (2218).

9. The display substrate (100) according to claim 8, wherein in the bonding region (1200, 2200), a height of the second transfer electrode pattern (2270) relative to a surface of the base substrate (1000, 2000) is not greater than a height of the bonding region (1200, 2200) third insulation layer (2260) relative to the surface of the base substrate (1000, 2000).

10. The display substrate (100) according to any one of claims 1-9, wherein the at least one bonding region insulation layer comprises a plurality of contact pad via holes (1216, 1219), and one of the plurality of contact pads (1210, 2210) is electrically connected to the one of the plurality of data leads (1220, 2220) through one of the plurality of contact pad via holes (1216, 1219).

11. The display substrate according to any one of claims 1-10, wherein the at least one group of contact pads comprise a first group of contact pads (1210, 2210) and a second group of contact pads (1210', 2210'), the first group of contact pads (1210, 2210) and the second group of contact pads (1210', 2210') respectively comprise a plurality of contact pads, the second group of contact pads (1210', 2210') are located at a side of the first group of contact pads (1210, 2210) close to the display region (1100), and the plurality of data leads (1220, 2220) are electrically connected with the first group of contact pads (1210, 2210) and the second group of contact pads (1210', 2210') in one-to-one correspondence.

12. The display substrate according to claim 11, wherein the plurality of contact pads of the first group of contact pads (1210, 2210) are arranged in at least a first row (L1), and the plurality of contact pads of the second group of contact pads (1210', 2210') are arranged in at least a second row (L2);

a row direction of the first row (L1) and a row direction of the second row (L2) are parallel to an extension direction of a side edge of the display region (1100) facing the bonding region (1200, 2200), and the first insulation layer (1230, 2230) comprises a first portion that is located in a gap between the first row (L1) and the second row (L2).

13. The display substrate according to claim 11 or 12, wherein the first insulation layer (1230, 2230) comprises a second portion that is located in gaps between adjacent contact pads in the first row, and gaps between adjacent contact pads in the second row.
14. The display substrate (100) according to any one of claims 1-13, wherein the at least one of the plurality of sub-pixels (110, 210) comprises:
15. The display substrate (100) according to claim 14, wherein the gate electrode (11211, 21211) and at least one of the plurality of data leads (1220, 2220) are provided at a same layer.
